text: So the month of practices aimed at harmonizing the fifth chakra has come to an end. I hope you practiced regularly and began to regularly realize how beautiful this world is, and more often began to feel inspiration and your own true values. Perhaps even in terms of health something changed for the better… And now I invite you not to lose the wave and continue the practices! For many years you have reinforced a certain way of thinking, values, habits, psychological clichés, and now you have only begun to free yourself from all of this, step by step discovering who you really are. Continuing to move in this direction will undoubtedly give you deeper results.
